text: Business and regulatory cycles will persist, but optimizing the relationship between indicators of financial crises and the regulatory sine curve, especially the timing of regulatory responses, could soften some of the effects of crises.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857

isBasedOn.name: Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry

abstract: While business and regulatory cycles are bound to persist, optimizing the relationship between indicators for financial crises and the regulatory sine curve, especially the timing of regulatory responses to crises, could soften some of the effects of regulatory crises.

value: cycles themselves are taken as given
